render: ran at build time across five widths; these counts are the static tier
agent: A coding agent followed Hallmark's full redesign while this demo was built and dealt the Dose theme. This browser does not call a model.

rules.evidence: eyebrow "Introducing Lumenboard · Beta" before <h1>
rules.change: The eyebrow, the Beta pill, and the section kickers are gone. Each block opens on its heading.

rules.evidence: <em>/<i> inside <h1>
rules.change: The italic word in the headline is gone. The line is roman: "Monday stays written."

rules.evidence: accented word inside a heading (h1 em)
rules.change: No word in the headline is set in a second colour or a gradient.

rules.evidence: italic display type on h1 em
rules.change: The display face is roman Schibsted Grotesk, from the Dose theme.

rules.evidence: purple-to-blue gradient text on .wordmark
rules.change: The purple-to-blue gradient is gone from the wordmark, the headline, and the buttons. Ink is solid, and the button is the theme green.

rules.evidence: display font "inter" (h1)
rules.change: The headline no longer uses Inter. Dose sets Schibsted Grotesk for display and Instrument Sans for text.

rules.evidence: font-family literal "Inter, system-ui, sans-serif" on body
rules.change: Colour and type now live in tokens.css. The page stylesheet refers to those tokens.

rules.evidence: dash "—" in copy
rules.change: The em dash, the buzzwords, Acme, Nexus, and Jane Doe are gone. The hero sentence is the studio and the three columns.

rules.evidence: hero paragraph runs 25 words
rules.change: The hero sentence is twelve words: "A small studio writes the week's calls in three columns."

rules.evidence: arrow glued to the label "Get started →"
rules.change: Labels are verbs with no arrow. "Fast · Secure · AI-native" and the green status dots are gone.

rules.evidence: .eyebrow: uppercase tracked 0.16em at 12px in a label role
rules.change: Labels are sentence case in the body face, without letter-spacing.

rules.evidence: re-drawn chrome selector .browser-bar
rules.change: The traffic-light browser frame is gone. The board is the three sentences, set as type.

rules.evidence: hero sized in vh: min-height: 100vh on .hero
rules.change: The hero is a ledge on the theme's paper, not a 100vh block.

rules.evidence: glass panel: backdrop-filter blur over a translucent white on nav
rules.change: The nav is a solid ink bar. The blur and the hairline are gone.

rules.evidence: default nav shape: 6 links + CTA + 1px hairline
rules.change: The nav is the Dose slab, and the stamp names it. The footer is a statement, not four link columns.

rules.evidence: no Hallmark stamp on the first non-empty line of any CSS
rules.change: board.css opens with the Hallmark stamp: Dose, full redesign, job sign up.

rules.evidence: no overflow-x: clip on html and body
rules.change: html and body use overflow-x: clip. The hero is not 100vw.

rules.evidence: transition: all on .btn
rules.change: Nothing uses transition: all. The button transition lists its properties.

rules.evidence: motion present, no prefers-reduced-motion block
rules.change: A reduced-motion rule cuts animation and transition time.

rules.evidence: padding: 14px 32px (off the 4px scale) on nav
rules.change: Spacing comes from the theme scale in tokens.css.

rules.evidence: no text-wrap: balance on any display head
rules.change: Display headings use text-wrap: balance.

rules.evidence: two filled buttons side by side in the hero
rules.change: The hero has one filled button. The other action is a text link.

rules.evidence: a hairline border under a wide soft shadow on .browser-bar
rules.change: The browser bar and its shadow are gone with the fake window.

rules.evidence: metric "12,000+ teams": verify the user supplied this number
rules.change: 12,000+ teams, 99.99% uptime, and 4.9/5 are gone. Nobody supplied a number, so the board does not invent one.

rules.evidence: numeric selector .stat b at display size without tabular figures
rules.change: The stat row is gone. The theme's figure style still sets tabular numbers.

rules.evidence: emoji icon "✨" in <span class="icon">
rules.change: The spark, bolt, and lock emoji are gone. Each column is a heading and its sentence.

rules.evidence: 3 equal icon-tile columns on .grid
rules.change: The three columns are stacked stages, not a row of equal icon cards.

rules.evidence: card nested in card: class="card inner"
rules.change: The quote card inside a card is gone, along with Jane Doe. The note is one form.

rules.evidence: a script prints success ("You're on the list") with no request behind it
rules.change: Submitting says the list is not wired. It does not say you joined.

rules.evidence: no :focus-visible styling anywhere
rules.change: Links, the email field, and the button show an instant focus ring.

rules.evidence: no :active styling anywhere
rules.change: The button and the field have an active state.

rules.evidence: the document lacks a meta description
rules.change: The Hallmark page has a meta description. The footer no longer says "All rights reserved."
